title: OpenText World 2026: What’s in it for healthcare and life sciences?
summary: OpenText World 2026 has healthcare and life sciences covered! Join us for sessions, breakouts, and advisory boards tailored to your needs.
body_markdown:
To find success with AI, healthcare and life sciences organizations first must prepare clinical, regulatory, and administrative records to support it. But how do you transform your underlying information so that it is governed, findable, and defensible?


[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?_gl=1*hsbl23*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mg..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODgyNzczNzkkbzYkZzEkdDE3ODgyOTAxMDIkajI3JGwwJGgxMTI4MDczNDgx) in Orlando, October 19–22, is the place to find answers to these questions and more. The event’s healthcare and life sciences focus—including speaker sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums—offers insight and advice about what’s on your mind today and what to think about for tomorrow.


Scott Lundstrom, OpenText Healthcare and Life Sciences Senior Industry Strategist, talks about what’s in store at OpenText 2026.


New to this year’s conference is the **Industry Advisory Board** for healthcare and life sciences. This focused gathering brings together senior industry leaders to discuss trends, challenges, and innovation opportunities. Participation is open to interested attendees and subject to approval to ensure a curated peer-to-peer experience. Find more information[here](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:b0383cbf-303c-4682-8546-a9e6973ac530) .


The conference also offers use cases, client success stories, how-to sessions, product roadmaps, round tables, and more. Here are just a few with a healthcare and life sciences lens that you won’t want to miss:


**[Client innovation in action: What’s possible with OpenText Content Management](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=666ad4e4-8708-4de9-9812-e4fcaf464b7b&shareLink=true)**


Tuesday, 2:00 p.m.


In this client-led showcase, you’ll see how peers are extending OpenText™ Content Management in practical, creative, and high-impact ways to improve how content is managed, connected, governed, and used across the enterprise.


**[Healthcare and life sciences industry client connect](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=8ee64a72-1159-4d43-b256-0ee781c0c15f&shareLink=true)**


Tuesday, 4:15 p.m.


Join us for an engaging discussion of what it takes to scale AI across healthcare and life sciences organizations. Leave with fresh ideas and a clearer path forward.


**[Healthcare and life sciences industry forum](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=899edeb7-f5fa-4c7f-bbb0-fb714831ee65&shareLink=true)**


Wednesday, 11:30 a.m.


Join industry peers to discuss how the landscape of healthcare and life sciences is rapidly changing. Share ideas about how to take control of your AI journey, unlock the intelligence of your enterprise data, and solve the challenges that keep your teams from moving faster.


Check our[webpage](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=7b993b06-54a0-4275-946b-a5b2359da862&shareLink=true) often for newly added sessions.
